name: order-handover
title: Order handover
for_each: select id,reference from orders order by reference

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select owner,note,due_on,completed_on from tasks where order_id=$1

name: dispatch-docket
title: Dispatch docket
for_each: select id,tracking from shipments order by shipped_on

sections.title: Dispatch record
sections.note: Internal record of dispatch supplied by the operator. This is not a carrier label or proof of delivery.
sections.sql: select o.reference,p.sku,s.quantity,s.warehouse,s.carrier,s.tracking,s.shipped_on,s.delivered_on,s.evidence from shipments s join order_lines l on l.id=s.line_id join orders o on o.id=l.order_id join products p on p.id=l.product_id where s.id=$1

name: return-review
title: Return review
for_each: select r.id,o.reference from returns r join order_lines l on l.id=r.line_id join orders o on o.id=l.order_id

sections.title: Case and decision
sections.note: Internal decision record. No payment, customer message or replacement order has been issued.
sections.sql: select o.reference,p.sku,r.quantity,r.reason,r.opened_on,r.review_by,r.outcome,r.evidence,r.resolved_on from returns r join order_lines l on l.id=r.line_id join orders o on o.id=l.order_id join products p on p.id=l.product_id where r.id=$1
